review_candidates.description: We Are Hiring For The Following Position Job Title: Project Engineer Location: Dammam, Saudi Arabia Key Responsibilities Project Planning: Finalize timescales, costs and resources with the consultant and contractor; prepare the overall project delivery plan and baseline schedule (Primavera P6 / MS Project) for the Project Manager's review and approval. Scope & Procurement: Develop detailed scopes of work for consultancy and contractor packages, support tendering and technical bid evaluation, and submit for review and approval by the Project Manager. Design Management: Manage design development with internal stakeholders and design consultants, covering civil works, canopy, forecourt, underground fuel storage tanks, piping, dispensers, electrical, fire-fighting and building works. Construction Management: Supervise site execution to ensure the contract is properly delivered within approved budget and time. Cost Control: Monitor project budgets, verify contractor progress payments, evaluate variations and claims, and keep costs within the approved budget. Schedule Control: Track progress against the baseline schedule, identify delays early and drive recovery plans resolve site issues and delays. HSE: Ensure health, safety and environmental requirements are met across all sites, including permit-to-work, hot work and excavation controls, especially at operating Risk & Change Management: Maintain the project risk register, manage change requests and stations. Quality: Ensure works meet approved drawings, specifications and standards (e.g. NFPA 30/30A, SASO, Saudi Building Code); review ITPs and attend inspections and tests. Permits & Authorities: Coordinate with municipality, Civil Defense, Ministry of Energy and utility companies (SEC, NWC) for permits, approvals and connections. Stakeholders & Team: Lead a multi-disciplinary internal and external team and act as the main point of contact for consultants, contractors, suppliers and station operations. Reporting: Prepare regular progress reports covering schedule, cost, HSE, quality and issues, and attend project progress meetings. Testing, Commissioning & Handover: Oversee testing and commissioning activities, close out snag lists and hand over as-built drawings and O&M manuals. Project Close-out: Complete contractual and financial close-out and record lessons learned. Proven record of managing multiple projects simultaneously from initiation to close-out, including planning, cost control, contract and subcontractor management. PMP or equivalent project management certification is preferred. Proficient in Primavera P6 or MS Project, AutoCAD, and MS Excel, Word & PowerPoint. Strong leadership, communication, negotiation and problem-solving skills; fluent in English, Arabic is an advantage. Valid Saudi driving license and willingness to travel between project sites.
